note: Databricks Community Edition does not support Jobs or scheduled workflows. Notebooks are executed manually or via serverless compute. The pipeline below documents the intended execution order as a conceptual job definition.

conceptual_pipelines.name: Acme_Sales_Pipeline
conceptual_pipelines.description: End-to-end Medallion Architecture pipeline for Acme Manufacturing sales analytics. Processes raw sales CSV data through bronze (ingestion), silver (cleaning/enrichment), and gold (aggregation/dimensions) layers. Output tables feed a Power BI semantic model for business reporting.

tasks.description: One-time: create bronze_customers and bronze_products reference tables
Ingest raw sales CSV into bronze_sales
Clean and enrich sales data into silver_sales
Enrich products with margins and tiers into silver_products
Aggregate silver_sales into gold_ft_sales fact table
